## Problem and change

Describe the user problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. Include browser/OS details for manual testing and note anything you could not verify.

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Screenshots

For visual changes, include before/after screenshots with non-sensitive sample images. Remove this section if it does not apply.

## Review notes

Call out compatibility changes, new dependencies, generated `docs/` updates, or remaining limitations. Remove this section if it does not apply.
